units.source_text: 这看不见的海，从耸立在志乐村后面的青叶山顶上就可以清楚地望及。

en.t: This invisible sea could be seen clearly from the summit of Mount Aoba, which rose behind Shira Village.

units.source_text: 我曾两次登上了青叶山。

en.t: I had climbed Mount Aoba twice.

units.source_text: 第二次攀登时，我正好望见联合舰队进舞鹤军港的情节。

en.t: On my second climb, I happened to see the Combined Fleet entering the naval port of Maizuru.
